title: Price rules, rate rules, extras and terms
text: Commercial terms per broker, dynamic pricing for seasons and last-minute, extras and rental terms.

title: Price rules: this broker’s own commercial terms.
text: Markup or discount, prices by day of the week, early-booking and last-minute changes, minimum days and closed dates.

title: Every rule shows an example price, so you see its effect before you save.
Rate rules (top menu): seasons, holidays and events, and last-minute pricing for the brokers you choose.
text: Prices are calculated day by day.

title: Seasons & events: Eid, Ramadan, Christmas or your own dates, each raising or lowering the price.
Last minute: prices that change with how soon the rental starts.
Try a price: shows the final price of any rental, step by step, before it reaches a broker.
Extras: what this broker may sell with a car, such as GPS, a child seat or an extra driver, and at what price.
Terms: the rental conditions sent with every quote and booking, in English and Arabic.
